notes: DOE final project report (Duke University, award DE-FC36-05GO15103), not a review, thesis, patent or abstract; it reports original data, so not_primary does not apply. The H2 uptake measurements were made by partner laboratories (NREL Sieverts and PCT-Pro, CalTech custom Sieverts, SwRI gravimetric) on PEEK-derived carbons made at Duke, and are reported as the project's results; treated as the paper's own measurements in a multi-laboratory paper. The report lists two earlier journal articles (publications 5 and 6) but does not state that every uptake value was published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. Not retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction statement in the text). Surface area is given as BET for the same PEEK-CO2-9-80 sample whose uptake is reported; Table 2 also gives NREL Sieverts 77 K, 2 bar uptake with BET area for carbon nanotube samples.
